definition: A long procession of people, vehicles, or animals.
author: Ann Ward Radcliffe
quote: These men could give no satisfactory answers to her enquiries, but, being roused by them, gazed in stupid astonishment upon the long cavalcade.
example_sentence: A cavalcade of vintage cars rolled through the village.
